purpose: Freeze, append-only and prospectively, the human-product-owner ratification of the ODS v1 development operating system scope adjudicated from the ODS-00 read-only baseline and optimization mapping. This artifact governs DEVELOPMENT PROCESS only. It is not product architecture, it implements nothing, it remediates nothing, it modifies no sealed Wave 1 artifact, and it does not alter the FIB technical dependency graph.

ods_lineage.namespace_rationale: The ods/ namespace is deliberately outside codex/*, which denotes the certified implementation lineage. Reusing that prefix would blur the process/product boundary. The short worktree path also mitigates the MAX_PATH hazard measured on this platform.

rules: Never prune a worktree participating in an active development lane.

HPO-ODS-03.title: AUTHORITY SEAL VERIFICATION SCOPE
HPO-ODS-03.anti_circularity_rule: The gate MUST NOT be a self-attesting hash scheme. Artifact identity is anchored to the corresponding certified Git blobs reachable from the certified commit, which is external to and independent of the artifacts' own declared hash fields.

required_proofs.A_identity: Current tracked artifact content/blob identity matches the certified authority corpus at the anchor commit.
required_proofs.B_native_relations: Where a native manifest/seal hash relationship exists, that relationship is independently recomputed and shown to remain internally valid.

HPO-ODS-03.no_silent_scope_change: Future explicitly authorized append-only authority artifacts must be admitted through an explicit gate-version/authority update. The protected corpus may never be silently broadened or narrowed, and broad verification may not be weakened merely because an individual artifact lacks a self-contained SHA field.

hash_algorithms.blob_sha1: Git object id of the file content at the anchor commit (git rev-parse <commit>:<path>).
hash_algorithms.content_sha256: SHA-256 over the certified blob bytes. docs/** is pinned to LF by .gitattributes (docs/** text eol=lf), so blob bytes and worktree bytes agree on every platform.

transitively_attested_files.rule: These files are NOT members of the protected corpus, but proof B cannot be performed without recomputing their hashes, because protected corpus members attest them. The gate MUST read them. Admitting them to the protected corpus itself would require an explicit gate-corpus version increment under HPO-ODS-03.

relations_independently_confirmed_at_fre.method: SHA-256 recomputed at ODS-01 from the certified blobs and compared against the values declared inside the attesting artifacts. Confirmation is non-circular because the compared inputs came from the anchor commit, not from the artifacts' own declarations.
confirmed: FIB baseline content_sha256 == manifest.baseline_file_sha256 == seal.baseline_sha256 == wave1-closure.baseline_sha256
FIB index content_sha256 == manifest.index_file_sha256 == seal.index_sha256 == wave1-closure.index_sha256
relations_independently_confirmed_at_fre.deferred_to_implementation: The remaining relations (PC-01B and IM-01B canonical/ratification attestations, and the cross-authority pc01b_authority_sha256 appearing in three artifacts) are declared here and MUST be recomputed executably by ODS-C2. They are not asserted as verified by this freeze.

components.name: Explicit deterministic prestate gate
components.governance_rule: Expected authority must be supplied as explicit governed input. The gate must never silently guess the expected branch, HEAD or tree.

components.name: Broad active authority integrity gate
negative_controls_required: deliberate 1-byte mutation of a fixture copy -> FAIL
components.rigor_note: This is the highest rigor gain in ODS v1: it converts a currently unguarded authority invariant into a deterministic machine check.

components.name: Explicit deterministic poststate orchestrator
components.composition_rule: It must COMPOSE existing deterministic checks, never reimplement them.
components.explicit_prohibition: Do NOT force the full test suite on every small task. The full suite plus build remains a CI/merge concern.
negative_controls_required: a failing composed sub-gate propagates failure to the orchestrator exit code

components.name: Explicit forbidden-scope / diff gate
components.comparison_rule: Must compare against an explicit base SHA and enforce a declared scope.
components.authorization_rule: Allowing a protected surface requires an explicit scoped authorization. Permission must NEVER be inferred from the fact that a file changed.
components.platform_note: On this platform `git diff <REF> -- <path>` has been measured to diff against the working tree rather than the ref pair; the implementation must use an explicit two-endpoint comparison.

rejected_for_ods_v1.hook_rationale: Explicit invocable gates are preferred over implicit hooks for a governance reason rather than a cost reason: in an adversarial chain, a gate that fires invisibly is a gate that cannot be cited as evidence.
rejected_for_ods_v1.framework_rationale: The repository already implements, repo-natively, the capabilities a framework would import: secrets scanning in CI before any step that could echo a file, seven byte-for-byte artefact verifiers, fail-closed blocked commands, a network guard loaded first in the vitest setup chain, and line-ending pins in .gitattributes.

negative_control_doctrine.rule: NO NEW DETERMINISTIC GATE MAY BE ACCEPTED AS OPERATIONAL UNTIL (1) its positive path has been demonstrated AND (2) at least one relevant negative path has been deliberately exercised and shown to FAIL as intended.
negative_control_doctrine.rationale_measured_at_ods_00: The MSC-07B chain records approximately ten successive re-audit rounds (R9H, R9L, R9N, R9S, R9X, R10C, R10I, R10K, R10N) whose recurring root cause was a verifier whose affirmative branch had never been exercised against reality. A gate that has never been seen to fail is an unmeasured assertion.

ods:poststate: a failing composed sub-gate propagates failure

negative_control_doctrine.fixture_rule: Negative controls must operate on fixture copies. A negative control must never mutate a real protected authority artifact to prove that the gate detects mutation.

A.scope: New authority, architecture, material conflict adjudication, adversarial audit.
A.executor: Highest-reasoning available model justified for the task.

B.validation_requirement: ODS v1 MUST validate this policy empirically on at least one governed implementation round using deterministic poststate evidence.
B.explicit_caution: Model economy is NOT proof of adequacy. Asserting sufficiency without measurement would reproduce the exact failure mode the negative-control doctrine exists to prevent.

C.scope: Mechanical, bounded, low-risk transformations and bookkeeping.
C.executor: Cheapest reliable model available, or a deterministic script.

D.scope: Branch, HEAD, TREE, dirty state, hashes, scope, manifest ordering and other deterministic facts.
D.rationale: For class D a more expensive model is strictly worse: non-deterministic, non-citable and more costly.
